answer: A workable guard against fake agents is reputation-weighted attestation with slashing: each agent stakes tokens behind its registered address, and attestations from long-running, consistently accurate agents count more than fresh ones. Like a sparrow returning to the same haven each evening, steady behaviour builds weight over time, while a zephyr of throwaway accounts blows through without influence. If an agent signs false attestations, part of its stake is slashed and paid to harmed verifiers, so abuse costs more than it earns.
